Tuesday. Of the Holy Apostles: Ananias, Matthias, Barnabas, Philip, John, Silas, and Silvanus. Tone 8 [դկ - dgi]: Heavenly Wisdom (Imasdootiun yergnayin), with its proper [canons]. Acts of the Apostles [Մկք. - error for Մանկունք/Children] and Evening Hymn [Հմբ. - Hambartsi] Tone 1 [ակ - ag]: Disciples of Christ. Midday Hymn Tone 1 [ակ - ag]: You who love. Psalm 18 [19]: Through all the earth. Prophet Zechariah 8:1: And the word came... to verse 3: the holy mountain. Acts 9:1: But Saul, still... to verse 22: this is the Christ. Alleluia: You shall make them. Gospel according to Luke 9:1: And having called the twelve... to verse 6: every place.

Wednesday. Questions [Harts] of Repentance. Midday Psalm 85 [86]: Save your servant. Apostle Galatians 2:11: But when he came... to verse 20: Jesus Christ. Alleluia: according to the Tone. Gospel according to Mark 13:14: And when... to verse 23: you everything.

Thursday. Of the Saints: Dionysius the Areopagite, and the Apostles: Timothy and Titus. Tone 8 [դկ - dgi]: Heavenly Wisdom, with its proper [canons]. Midday Psalm 18 [19]: Through all the earth. Prophet Isaiah 33:2: Lord, have mercy... to verse 6: treasures of righteousness. Acts 17:16: And in Athens... to verse 34: and others with them. Apostle 2 Thessalonians 1:1: Paul and Silvanus... to verse 12: of Jesus Christ. Alleluia: You shall make them. Gospel according to Luke 10:1: After this... to verse 7: of his reward.

Friday. Questions [Harts] of Rest. Midday Psalm 97 [98]: All have seen. Apostle Galatians 2:20: But what now... to 3:12: shall live in them. Alleluia: according to the Tone. Gospel according to Mark 13:24: But in those days... [to verse] 37: stay awake.

Saturday. Of the Holy Evangelists: Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John. Tone 5 [գձ - ka]: Blessed holy Apostles, with its proper [canons]. Magnificat [Մեծ. - Medzoutse] Tone 1 [աձ - ah]: Today the new. Children [Մկք. - Mangoonk] Tone 1 [ակ - ag]: Disciples of Christ. Midday Hymn Tone 1 [ակ - ag]: You who love. Psalm 95 [96]: Proclaim. Proverbs [Wisdom] 9:13: For who is a man... to 10:2: to have all. Prophet Ezekiel 1:3: And the word of the Lord came... to verse 11: their bodies. Prophet Zechariah 6:1: I turned and... to verse 8: in the north country. Apostle Ephesians 3:7 [error for 4:7]: But to each... to verse 13: [of] Christ. Alleluia: You shall make them. Gospel according to Luke 6:13: And when it was day... to verse 19: everyone. In the Evening: Joyful Light. Mesedi: I loved. Evening Hymn [Հմբ. - Hambartsi] Tone 1 [աձ - ah]: Holy art thou, Lord, and, From thee we entreat.

Sixth Sunday after the Holy Cross. Questions [Harts] Tone 7 [դձ - da]: When on the cross. Magnificat [Մեծ. - Medzoutse]: Mother of Light, Mary. Midday Psalm 64 [65]: To thee is due. Prophet Isaiah 20:2: Thus says the Lord to Isaiah... to 21:6: declare. Apostle Galatians 4:3: So we also... to verse 18: I may be in your [midst]. Alleluia: of the Resurrection, according to the Tone. Gospel according to Luke 4:14: And Jesus returned... to verse 23: in your own country.

Monday. Of the Saints: Longinus the Centurion who believed at the crucifixion of the Lord Christ, and Joseph the Father of God, and Joseph of Arimathea, and the friend of Christ, Lazarus, and his sisters Martha and Mary. Tone 6 [գկ - gi]: Heavenly Wisdom, with its proper [canons]. Children [Մկք. - Mangoonk] Tone 6 [գկ - gi]: To the oil-bearing women. Midday Introit: Apostles. Hymn Tone 7 [դձ - da]: Joseph the righteous. Psalm 14 [15]: Those who fear the Lord. Proverbs 15:27: By mercy... to verse 32: gains understanding. Prophet Joel 2:12: And now, thus says the Lord... to verse 13: of the evils of men. Apostle 1 Timothy 1:12: I give thanks... to verse 17: forever, Amen. Alleluia: You shall make them. Gospel according to Matthew 27:50: And Jesus, having cried out... to verse 61: the tomb.

Tuesday. Of the Saints: Theodoton the Priest, and Zenon the Soldier, and Macarius, Eudoxius, and Romulus. Questions [Harts] of the Martyrs. Midday Psalm 91 [92]: It is good to confess. Proverbs [Wisdom] 1:11: My son, henceforth... to verse 15: is immortal.
